name: Coconut Cream
ingredients: Coconut kernel extract (92%), water, stabilisers (412, 466), emulsifier (435).
storage: STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE. ONCE OPENED TRANSFER UNUSED CONTENTS INTO A NON-METALLIC CONTAINER AND REFRIGERATE. CONSUME WITHIN 2 DAYS.
note: Servings per pack printed '7 approx.' at 60 mL. No net volume is printed on either photographed face, so pack is unrecorded rather than inferred from 7 x 60. No allergen statement anywhere on the panel — that absence is recorded in needs, not read as 'allergen free'. Front of pack carries 'DAIRY FREE', 'VEGETARIAN & VEGAN FRIENDLY', 'NO ADDED COLOURS OR FLAVOURS'. Barcode is on the far edge of the can and only its bars are in frame.
